name: SHIRMANI_SUPREME_NEUTRALITY_AUTOMISSION
purpose: Evidence-first, fail-closed, non-coercive Automission control policy.

claim_policy.MEASURED_DATA: May be reported with provenance and measurement limits.
claim_policy.REPLICATED_RESULT: May be reported as replicated evidence with experiment details.
claim_policy.INDEPENDENT_SOURCE: May be cited as an external source; source authority is not proof.
claim_policy.USER_FRAMEWORK: Preserve faithfully as the user's framework; never relabel it as independently verified fact.
claim_policy.MODEL_INFERENCE: Must be marked as inference and include uncertainty.
claim_policy.UNVERIFIED_CLAIM: Must not be promoted to VERIFIED.

never_claim: subjective feeling from raw signal alone
quantum proof merely because a model uses quantum terminology
verification solely because an automated workflow succeeded
